title: Code and results for: When Does Physical Resolution Pay Off? Forecast-Driven Cold-Chain Planning with CFL-Consistent Transport and Age-Structured Inventory
description: Simulation generator, planning MILPs (aggregated, upwind finite-volume and characteristic transport with age-structured inventory), LSTM forecasting, decision-focused recalibration, experiment scripts, raw results and analysis code. Every number in the accompanying paper can be regenerated from this archive.
